messages:
maria-support: FYI customer reports that Console -> Analytics -> Export CSV returns a 0-byte file for a custom date range. Preset ranges (last 7/30 days) work fine. They attached repro steps and a screenshot.

sasha-analytics: Thanks, can you paste the exact steps + date window they used? any timezone involved?

maria-support: Steps from customer: open Console > Analytics > Usage, set start = 2026-03-01 13:00, end = 2026-03-02 12:59, click Export CSV. Download completes but file size 0 bytes. They said their org is UTC+2.

dylan-backend: Can you share the export job id if available? Also which preset they tried that worked?

maria-support: Job id shown in UI: job_20260301_8237. They said presets (Last 24 hours, Last 7 days) produced normal CSVs. Only custom ranges > crossing day boundary at non-midnight time fail.

raj-backend: Looking at logs for job_20260301_8237 — export-worker returned HTTP 200 but body-length = 0. There's an exception in analytics-agg: "WindowAggregator: computed window size = 0; no shards queried" — could be a rounding bug when converting local timezone to UTC bucket.

export-bot: export-worker job_20260301_8237 status: FAILED -> empty-output. Reason: aggregation-window-zero (trace id 01F8ZQ).

dylan-backend: Repro locally with user's TZ: ran query to compute buckets: ```sql
SELECT bucket_start, bucket_end FROM time_buckets('2026-03-01T11:00:00Z','2026-03-02T10:59:00Z', 'hour');
``` Results showed start >= end for last bucket when input converted with DST offset. Looks like our date parsing uses end-exclusive but then subtracts one second incorrectly for non-midnight ranges.

sasha-analytics: This matches a bug we saw in sprint 21 where timezone offsets plus end-exclusive semantics yielded empty ranges for some inputs. We thought we fixed midnight-edge cases but not arbitrary hour offsets.

maria-support: Customer is blocked. Any idea for a quick workaround we can give them?

raj-backend: Short-term workaround: ask them to set end to 2026-03-02 13:00 (one minute later covers the inclusive window) or use preset ranges. Not great but will produce CSV. We're rolling a hotfix to treat computed window length <=0 as inclusive fallback.

dylan-backend: Pushing patch to fix range calculation now. Diff: change end_time = min(end_time, start_time + max(1s, computed_window)). Adding unit tests for TZ conversions.

export-bot: deploy:backend v1.42.7 -> canary started (raj, dylan).

sasha-analytics: I'll add an alert to monitoring to catch future zero-byte exports (metric: export.file_bytes == 0). Also add an annotation in Console UI to warn users when custom range results in empty dataset.

maria-support: Thanks all — I'll update the customer with workaround and ETA for fix. Will follow up when canary confirms non-empty CSVs. :thumbsup:

dylan-backend: Canary passed on canary-1 after patch. Verified job_20260302_test produced 1.2MB CSV for same custom range.

maria-support: Customer confirmed download succeeded after we asked them to bump end by 1 minute. They were happy with hotfix timeline. Closing once patch reaches prod.

sasha-analytics: Filed tracking ticket: AN-4593 "csv export: zero-bytes for non-midnight custom ranges (timezone conversion bug)" with reproducer and tests.

maria-support: Closing loop. Recorded customer repro & resolution in CRM ticket #C-5874.
